_note: The extension period of the case's type, copied onto the case beside statutoryTerm, so Termijn en betaling reads "4 weken, te verdagen met 2" (nextcloud-vue data widget format duration + extendBy). Materialised for the same reason as statutoryTerm: a cross-object @ref resolves only in OpenRegister's save-time listener. case moves to 1.55.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

statutoryExtension.title: Statutory extension
statutoryExtension.description: The extension period of this case's type, as an ISO 8601 duration. Copied from caseType.extensionPeriod by x-openregister-calculations.statutoryExtension.

The case type's extension period, copied onto the case so the term row can say by how much the term may be extended. A case type whose extension period changes later needs occ openregister:rematerialise-calculations, as statutoryTerm does.
